```rust
fn wait(&self) {
    let mut count = self.mutex.lock().unwrap();
    while *count == 0 {
        count = self.condvar.wait(count).unwrap();
    }
    *count -= 1;
}

fn signal(&self) {
    let mut count = self.mutex.lock().unwrap();
    *count += 1;
    self.condvar.notify_one();
}
```
